name: Honoka
source:
The Timid Girl with a Crush

An honest girl who’s always on your side, it’s difficult for Honoka to hide the jealousy she feels around Konoha and Kisara. After you go missing over and over, it’s only a matter of time until she finds out the truth.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/GeniusBishoujo/status/1498644455582228486?s=20&t=7sljkuwCRMbHa_q_aEPXMQ]official Twitter[/url]]
